summary_text: Midday departure with limited same-day recovery options. Weather disruption causing a severe delay. Significant misconnections at a major hub. Delayed 190 minutes. Medium passenger load of 147 passengers, 23 misconnecting, 21 already missed and 2 at risk. 11 priority passengers affected. Same-day reaccommodation is still possible but options are thinning. 3 passengers require special handling assistance. Narrow-body aircraft. Flight ZZ1137 CDG to OSL.
